Rashi on Berakhot 32a:12:1.hebrew: מלי כריסיה זני בישי - מילוי הכרס הוא ממיני חטאים הרעים. זני — מתרגמינן ״למינהו״: ״לזנוהי״ (בראשית א):
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:12:1.english: Filling his stomach [is of] bad kinds - Filling the stomach is among the kinds of evil sins. [As for the word] zenei — we translate [in the Targum] leminehu [“after its kind”] as liznohi (Genesis 1).

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:14:1.hebrew: הרף ממני - הראהו שיש כח בידו למחול ע"י תפלה:
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:14:1.english: Leave Me be - [God] showed him that He had the power to forgive through prayer.

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:16:1.hebrew: הניחה לי - משמע שהיה אוחז בו:
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:16:1.english: Leave Me be - This implies that he was holding Him.

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:17:1.english: Three legs - Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:19:1.hebrew: שהחלהו - הפציר בו, אנויי"ר בלע"ז:
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:19:1.english: That he made Him ill - He importuned Him — ennuyer in Old French.

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:19:2.english: His vow - His statement, when He said: “And I will consume them.”

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:1:1.hebrew: דכתיב ואשר הרעותי - רישא דקרא: "אוספה הצולעה והנדחה אקבצה". "ואשר הרעותי" — אני גרמתי להם, שבראתי יצר הרע:
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:1:1.english: As it is written: “And those with whom I have dealt in wickedness” - The beginning of the verse [is]: “I will assemble the lame, and I will gather the outcast.” “And those with whom I have dealt in wickedness” — I caused them [to sin], as I created the evil inclination.

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:20:1.hebrew: שמסר עצמו למיתה - ויחל לשון חלל:
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:20:1.english: That he gave himself over to death - “Vayḥal” is an expression of ḥalal [a slain person].

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:21:1.hebrew: שהחלה עליהם מדת רחמים - כמו יחולו על ראש יואב (שמואל ב ג׳:כ״ט), לשון הניח:
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:21:1.english: That he caused the Attribute of Mercy to rest upon them - Like "May they fall upon the head of Joab" (II Samuel 3:29), an expression of causing to rest.

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:23:1.english: That an aḥilu seized him - [This is the textual] reading.

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:23:2.hebrew: אשתא דגרמי - מוליי"ר בלע"ז:
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:23:2.english: Fever of the bones - Meoliere, in Old French [meaning marrow fever].

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:24:1.hebrew: אשר נשבעת להם בך - שנאמר בעקדת יצחק: ״בי נשבעתי״ (בראשית כב):
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:24:1.english: To whom You swore to them by Yourself - As it is stated at the Binding of Isaac: “By Myself have I sworn” (Genesis 22).

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:26:1.english: To this point - Until [the words] “as the stars of heaven.”

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:26:2.hebrew: מכאן ואילך דברי הרב - אמר לו: אעשה כדבריך:
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:26:2.english: From this point on [are] the words of the Master - [God] said to him: “I will do according to your words.”

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:26:3.hebrew: דברים שאמרת לי - בסנה אמרת לי: ״אעלה אתכם מעני מצרים אל ארץ טובה ורחבה״ (שמות ג׳:י״ז):
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:26:3.english: Matters that You said to me - At the bush You said to me: “I will bring you up out of the affliction of Egypt to a good and spacious land” (Exodus 3:17).

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:2:1.hebrew: אלמלא שלש מקראות הללו - שמעידין שיש ביד הקדוש ברוך הוא לתקן יצרנו ולהסיר יצר הרע ממנו:
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:2:1.english: Had it not been for these three verses - Which testify that it is in the power of the Holy One, Blessed be He, to rectify our inclination and remove the evil inclination from us.

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:2:2.hebrew: נתמוטטו - רגלינו במשפט, אבל עכשיו יש לנו פתחון פה, שהוא גרם לנו, שברא יצר הרע:
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:2:2.english: Would have collapsed - [That is,] our feet in judgment; but now we have a defense, for He caused [this] for us, in that He created the evil inclination.

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:31:1.english: You have given Me life - Before the nations.

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:5:1.hebrew: הטיח - לשון זריקה, כמו כמטחוי קשת (בראשית כא):
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:5:1.english: Hurled - An expression of casting, as in: “as it were a bowshot” (Genesis 21).

Rashi on Berakhot 32a:9:1.hebrew: אין ארי נוהם - שמח, ומשתגע ומזיק:
Rashi on Berakhot 32a:9:1.english: A lion does not roar - [He is] rejoicing, acting wild, and causing damage.
